title: Capability clusters
description: The catalog of capability clusters Naive ships at packages/naive/src/functions/it/capability-clusters.json (lead agents design, "Capability clusters and connections", from the whole-venture monorepo thesis). The thesis asks, for each function, what an outside tool gives that GitHub plus Naive cannot, and groups the answers into clusters with one outside tool per cluster, not one per function. Each cluster names the functions (packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json ids) that depend on it and the gap kinds that justify an outside tool. It names no vendor: every object here allows only the properties listed, so a vendor, tool or product field fails the schema. A venture's connection record (connection.schema.json) names its cluster and its own system.

gap_kinds.description: Why GitHub plus Naive is not enough, strongest reason first.

weakest.description: True for the one reason that alone rarely justifies a connection (a UI preference).

functions.description: The functions that depend on the cluster, ids in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json (packages/naive/src/checks/check-connections.ts checks them).

gaps.description: The gap kinds that justify an outside tool for this cluster, ids from gap_kinds.

why.description: What the outside tool gives that GitHub plus Naive cannot, in the thesis's words where it has them.

thesis.description: The thesis's own list of who depends on the cluster, kept as written (it names uses, such as payroll or product email, that are not function ids).
